original_orca_lane.reason: No licensed ORCA executable is available locally; no substitute is represented as ORCA.

open_three_program_lane.program_identity_rule: NWChem is an independent open-source third implementation, not an ORCA replacement or ORCA-equivalent claim.

estimand.definition: Gaussian-style B3LYP total electronic energy or its Cartesian/projected first derivative at a frozen Cartesian geometry, spherical Gaussian basis, no empirical dispersion and no density fitting.

functional_identity.components: 0.20 HF exchange + 0.80 Slater exchange + 0.72 B88 nonlocal exchange + 0.19 VWN_1_RPA local correlation + 0.81 LYP correlation

numerical_contract.grid_convergence_policy: Use the frozen high grids below. Output must prove the requested grid was actually adopted.

derivative_contract.full_cartesian_gradient_comparison: RMS over all 3N Cartesian components in hartree/bohr
derivative_contract.projected_force_comparison: same normalized frozen tangent and same signed convention in all programs

calibration_evidence.note: The initial Psi4 calibration used DIRECT with its default DF pre-iteration guess. Production and final calibration disable that guess with DF_SCF_GUESS=false.

failure_rule: Retain every failed run. Do not tune settings against V0.1 proposition outcomes. Any core anchor outside tolerance is INDETERMINATE for the open-three-program lane.
gate_rule: The open-three-program lane can pass only after all eight frozen core anchors and required energy/force observables pass. The original ORCA lane remains NOT_ESTABLISHED until licensed ORCA results exist.
